events.name: The Drowned Anchor
rumors: Sage Orrin lives by the docks in the south-east. Knows more about old magic than anyone alive.
The Hollow Crypt is full of the restless dead. Holy magic works wonders there.
A lich rules the crypt. They say it cannot be put to sleep - the dead never sleep.
The crystal door in the northern mountains has been sealed for a thousand years.
Trolls heal their wounds unless you burn them.
Our armory sells plate mail, if you've the coin.
Thornwick's forge in the Ashen Hills makes dwarven mail lighter than plate and nearly as strong.
The ferry at the north dock crosses to Port Ashkar on the desert coast - a hundred gold, and worth it if you're tough enough for the Wastes.

events.name: Sage Orrin's House
events.text: Sage Orrin presses the Frost Shard against a red glow only he can see - Pell's working, sent by letter. With a crack of thunder the halves fuse. "The Vault Sigil, whole again! The Inner Vault lies in the northern mountains of the wilds. Beware its Warden."

events.name: Sage Orrin's House
events.text: Sage Orrin squints at you. "Shards? Bring me the Frost Shard from the Hollow Crypt, once Archivist Pell has sent word of the Ember Shard."

events.name: Sage Orrin's House
events.text: "The Inner Vault waits in the northern mountains. Go with courage."

events.name: Ferry to Port Ashkar
events.failText: The ferryman shakes his head. "A hundred gold to cross to Port Ashkar. The desert coast is a long way south."
events.text: The ferry carries you south across the bay to Port Ashkar on the Sunscar Coast.

events.name: Harbor
events.text: Fishing boats bob at their moorings. A sailor mutters about storms that come earlier every year.
